veranderings.voor: Om vuil water skoon te maak is twee verskillende werke.
veranderings.na: Om vuil water skoon te maak, is twee verskillende take.
veranderings.rede: 'Werke' for jobs/tasks reads as 'works' (as in waterwerke); 'take' is the natural word, and a comma after the opening om...te clause separates it from the verb.

veranderings.blok: Vier maniere om water helderder te maak
veranderings.voor: lap of sand. Stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies bly agter.
veranderings.na: lap of sand. Stukkies wat te groot is vir die gaatjies, bly agter.
veranderings.rede: A comma after the embedded relative clause keeps 'is' and 'bly' from colliding; optional under the AWS, so the reviewer may prefer to match the decided filtreer definition, which has none.

veranderings.voor: Die kleurstof het opgelos en sy deeltjies
veranderings.na: Die kleurstof het opgelos, en sy deeltjies
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: kan ook kieme in water doodmaak en die waterwerke
veranderings.na: kan ook kieme in water doodmaak, en die waterwerke
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
'Soos die pakkie sê' calques 'as the packet says'; 'soos op die pakkie staan' is the idiomatic Afrikaans.
The protected-word reasons say 'die kieme' reads as all germs; dropping the article matches the lesson's own protected wording 'maak kieme dood' without changing the point.

veranderings.blok: Die waterwerke: voordat ons die water gebruik
veranderings.voor: 'n Sif vang eers die groot goed en dan staan
veranderings.na: 'n Sif vang eers die groot stukke, en dan staan
veranderings.rede: 'Die groot goed' is loose and colloquial; 'groot stukke' matches the sieve block and definition, and the AWS comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects.

veranderings.voor: Jy oordeel watter filter beter werk aan hoe helder die water uitkom.
veranderings.na: Jy oordeel watter filter beter werk deur te kyk hoe helder die water uitkom.
veranderings.rede: 'Oordeel ... aan hoe' strands the preposition after the embedded question and reads awkwardly; 'deur te kyk hoe' is clear and keeps the meaning.
The protected-word reasons say 'die kieme' reads as all germs and the lesson must never imply all germs; 'maak kieme dood' is the protected wording.

vlae.rede: If 'werke' becomes 'take' in the opening sentence, the block heading should change to 'Twee verskillende take' to match; the heading's text also occurs in the sentence, so it was not proposed as a separate change.
